assessments.reasoning: Chapter 5 describes imports as bringing entities into a module's scope and exports as making entities available to other modules. Section 5.2 allows a module to export an entity it defines or imports and specifies the default when the export list is omitted.

limitations: An omitted export list has a documented default, so this description does not imply every module spells out an explicit list.
